outcome: Melding exiles both cards and returns them to the battlefield as one permanent with the combined back face up.
A meld card's back face outside a melded permanent determines no characteristics.
An instruction to transform or convert a meld card is ignored and the card keeps its face.

note: players looking at cards is a physical-game matter
hidden-zone card handling and sleeves are physical

outcome: A double-faced card in a zone other than the battlefield or stack shows only its front face's characteristics.
A meld card on the stack has only its front face's characteristics.
A double-faced spell cast transformed has its back face's characteristics but a mana value from the front face's mana cost.
A double-faced permanent with its front face up has only its front face's characteristics.
A nonmodal permanent with its back face up has back-face characteristics but the front face's mana value, or 0 if it is a copy of the back face.
A modal double-faced spell or permanent has only the characteristics of the face that is up.
A melded permanent has the combined back face's characteristics and the sum of the front faces' mana values, or 0 as a copy.
Transform or convert instructions change only permanents that are double-faced cards or tokens; any other permanent is unchanged.
A transform or convert instruction does nothing when the destination face is an instant or sorcery face.
A double-faced spell is put on the stack front face up by default.
A double-faced card cast transformed or converted is put on the stack with its back face up.
Only the face that would be up on the stack is evaluated to decide whether the card can be cast.
A front-face ability allowing the card to be cast transformed is also considered when deciding whether it can be cast.

note: the face choice has no separate outcome; the face entering is covered by 712.8f

outcome: A resolving double-faced spell enters the battlefield with the face that was up on the stack.
A spell told to enter transformed whose back face is an instant or sorcery goes to its owner's graveyard instead of entering.
A double-faced card put onto the battlefield from a zone other than the stack enters front face up by default.
A double-faced card put onto the battlefield transformed enters back face up; a non-double-faced card stays in its zone.
A modal double-faced card whose front face is not a permanent card stays in its zone when put onto the battlefield.
Two melding cards enter the battlefield as a single permanent with their back faces up.

note: face-down double-faced cards are physical handling; the face-down characteristics are covered in 708

outcome: A face-down double-faced permanent does not transform; turned face up it has its front face up.
An effect turning a melded or double-faced permanent face down does nothing and changes no characteristics.
A permanent that transforms stays the same object and keeps effects that applied to it.
An 'as this transforms' ability is applied during the transformation, not after it.
A melded permanent leaving the battlefield is one permanent leaving and two cards entering the new zone.

note: the owner arranges the two cards
the exiling player determines the relative timestamp order

outcome: An effect that finds the object a melded permanent became finds both cards and acts upon each.
A replacement effect applied to a melded permanent leaving the battlefield affects both cards.
A melded permanent counts as one object moved and two cards moved.
